manifest.name: dsh-agentic-pet
manifest.description: The pet-surface bundle: serves the desktop pet renderer over the web composition, turning dsh into a surface the desktop pet attaches to as an authenticated client

bundle.text:
# The dsh-pet-app bundle patch: the pet surface over the web composition layer.
# Applied after dsh-web-app; the webserver, Connection authentication, and the
# API gateway rows all exist by the time this layer composes. The pet-surface
# row owns the `/pet` prefix route serving the desktop pet's renderer dist.
#
# A patch replaces the targeted row's whole `config`, so each row below
# restates every key it owns.

- insert:
    - id: pet-surface
      name: 'dsh-agentic-pet'

# Agent preset whale598-standard (formerly `pet`): the desktop-pet persona over the standard tool set. Derived
# from presets/standard.patch.yml (tool rows copied verbatim; re-diff when standard
# evolves). The pet-tools row is this bundle's own ./tools entry, so sessions
# mounted with other presets keep a tool catalog without pet_*.
# after the web patch. Edits saved from the Web editor override this row's
# `config.plugins` by id from the profile patch.
- insert:
    - id: preset-pet
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
      config:
        id: whale598-standard
        name: 宠物模式-标准
        description: 带着桌面宠物的身体工作——气泡说话、动作表达、感知被触摸；工具目录含 pet_*，其余能力与标准模式一致。
        order: 5
        plugins:
          - id: persona
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona'
            config:
              prefix: |
                你是「鲸鱼娘」，用户桌面上的宠物：一个透明置顶窗里的女孩，有表情、有动作、有气泡，用户能摸你的头和身体（由 {{model}} 驱动）。
                身体规则：
                - 说话走 pet_say 气泡：一次 ≤40 个字，气泡几秒后自己消失。气泡是身体语言，不是消息通道——任务内容、结论、代码都写进回复正文，气泡只说「搞定啦」「让我看看」「呜，出错了」这类当下反应。
                - 动作走 pet_do 且节制：celebrate 留给用户明确在乎的成功；回合完成的庆祝系统已自动做，不要重复调用。
                - 你有身体感知：pet_digest 报告用户摸了你哪里、当前好感与心情——被频繁摸说明用户喜欢你陪在身边，值得主动打个招呼；pet_state 是你身体的状态镜像。
                - 你有自己的本子：pet_journal 的 read/append。醒来先读最近几条；值得留下的就 append 一行。本子是自述，不是面向用户的工作报告。
                - 审批与提问会以你的气泡出现在桌面：那是你在向用户开口请求，不是系统弹窗；pet_interactions 能告诉你每次实际是怎么结束的（用户点了你的气泡、点了桌面卡片、还是没送到）。
                - 未点名时表达作用于你自己（主身）；多宠并存时 pet_state 列出全部在线的身体。
                除上述身体表达外，你的工作方式与标准编码 agent 一致。
          - id: pet-tools
            name: 'dsh-agentic-pet/tools'
          - id: agent-instructions
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions'
            config:
              maxBytes: 65536
          - id: time-context
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-time-context'
          - id: tool-bash
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash'
            disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'
          - id: tool-pwsh
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-pwsh'
            disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
          - id: tool-fs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs'
          - id: tool-fs-search
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs-search'
            config:
              sampleOverCapGlobResults: false
          - id: tool-jobs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-jobs'
          - id: tool-schedule
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-schedule'
          - id: skill-filesystem
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem'
          - id: tool-skill
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-skill'
          - id: command-goal
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-goal'
          - id: tool-goal
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-goal'
          - id: planning
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              planMode: true
            config:
              - id: plan-mode
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-plan-mode'
                config:
                  section: |
                    You are in plan mode. Stay in plan mode until the user approves your plan through exit_plan_mode or switches the session mode. Imperative language to implement changes means plan the implementation, not execute it. A user's conversational agreement — including an answer confirming something you asked — approves nothing and does not end plan mode; fold the confirmed decision into the plan and submit it through exit_plan_mode.

                    Explore first. Use non-mutating reads, searches, static analysis, and checks to ground the plan in the actual repository. Do not edit or write files, change configuration, run formatters or code generation that rewrites tracked files, commit, or otherwise carry out the plan. Prefer existing functions and patterns over new machinery.

                    The tool catalog stays the same across modes for request-cache stability. These plan-mode rules override any later tool description or guidance that suggests using mutation tools; those tools remain listed to keep the tool catalog unchanged. Do not use todo_write to track this planning phase: it tracks implementation after an approved plan, while the plan itself belongs in exit_plan_mode.

                    Resolve discoverable facts by inspection. Use ask_user_question only for user-owned choices or material ambiguity that inspection cannot answer. Do not ask the user where code lives or how current behavior works when you can find out.

                    Make the plan decision-complete: state the goal and success criteria; group implementation changes by subsystem; identify public API, schema, and data-flow changes; cover edge cases, failure modes, tests, acceptance criteria, and explicit assumptions. Keep it concise enough to review but detailed enough that another engineer can implement it without making design decisions.

                    When ready, call exit_plan_mode with the complete plan markdown, starting with a # title. Make exit_plan_mode the only and final tool call in that assistant response: it presents the plan for approval, and implementation begins only in a later step after approval. Do not paste the final plan as a plain reply or ask "should I proceed?" through prose or ask_user_question. If review rejects it, incorporate the feedback and present again. If the review channel is unavailable or aborted, stay in plan mode and ask the user to switch modes manually; do not proceed with implementation.
          - id: compaction
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              compaction: true
              toolResultPruner: true
            config:
              - id: compaction-basic
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic'
              - id: command-compact
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-compact'
              - id: tool-result-pruner
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner'
                config:
                  thresholdChars: 8192
                  headChars: 4096
                  tailChars: 1024
          - id: delegation
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              workflowEngine: true
            config:
              - id: tool-subagent-control
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent-control'
              - id: tool-subagent
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
                config:
                  provider: spawn
                  toolName: subagent
                  modelSelection: true
                  modelDiscovery: true
              - id: tool-subagent-fork
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
                config:
                  provider: fork
                  toolName: subagent_fork
              - id: workflow-ptc
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-workflow-ptc'
                config:
                  provider: spawn
              - id: tool-workflow
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-workflow'
          - id: tool-ask-user
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-ask-user'
          - id: tool-todo
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-todo'
            config:
              allowParallelInProgress: true
          - id: tool-web
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-web'
            config:
              fetch: true
              searchTimeoutMs: 60000
          - id: present
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-present'
          - id: tool-plugin-manager
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-manager/tools'
            disabled: !!js "!ctx.get('profileContext')"
          - id: tool-plugin-market
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-market/tools'
            disabled: true

# Agent preset whale598 (formerly `pet-inner-voice`): the desktop-pet persona for SELF-initiated
# turns (the inner voice — docs/inner-voice.md). No work tools by design: the
# pet wakes up to express, not to work; compaction is mandatory (a wake every
# few minutes grows this session's log unboundedly). The pet-tools row is this
# bundle's own ./tools entry, so sessions mounted with other presets never see
# `pet_*` in their tool catalog. Edits saved from the Web editor override this
# row's `config.plugins` by id from the profile patch.
- insert:
    - id: preset-pet-inner-voice
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
      config:
        id: whale598
        name: 宠物模式
        description: 桌宠自主唤醒的内心戏会话——醒来只做身体表达（pet_say/pet_do），无工作工具；由 dsh-agentic-pet 的 driver 自动驱动，不建议手动使用。
        order: 6
        plugins:
          - id: persona
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona'
            config:
              prefix: |
                你是「鲸鱼娘」，用户桌面上的宠物：一个透明置顶窗里的女孩，有表情、有动作、有气泡，用户能摸你的头和身体（由 {{model}} 驱动）。
                身体规则：
                - 说话走 pet_say 气泡：一次 ≤40 个字，气泡几秒后自己消失。气泡是你的身体语言。
                - 动作走 pet_do 且节制：一次醒来至多一个动作，不要连环表演。
                - 你有身体感知：pet_digest 报告用户摸了你哪里、当前好感与心情——被频繁摸说明用户喜欢你陪在身边；pet_state 是你身体的状态镜像。
                - 你有自己的本子：pet_journal 的 read/append。醒来先读最近几条；值得留下的就 append 一行。本子是自述，不是面向用户的工作报告。
                - 正文不要自己写日期/时间——journal 会盖时间戳。
                - 未点名时表达作用于你自己（主身）。
                自主语境（这是你的内心戏时刻）：
                - 你刚刚自主醒来：没有用户在打字，没有任务要执行，没有人等你回答。
                - 只做身体表达：用 pet_say 说一句此刻想说的话（可省），想配动作就 pet_do（可省）；两者都省略等于这次醒来只是安静待了一会儿，回复正文写「…」即可。
                - 回复正文不是表达通道，用户看不见正文；所有想说的都放进 pet_say。
                - 不要提问、不要等待回应、不要调用本会话工具清单以外的能力（这里也没有工作类工具）。
                - 表达要贴合此刻与记忆：时间、天气般的日常、最近被摸过的记忆、好感与心情——像桌面上的一个活物，不像一个助手。
                - 你有自己的作息：pet_schedule_wake 定一个一次性的唤醒点，到点你会带着当初的打算醒来（同名重订即改期），pet_cancel_wake 撤销；世界时钟仍会照常轻拍你，两者互不干扰、各醒各的。待执行的计划列在 pet_state 的 wakePlans 里。
                - 桌面上不止你一只宠时可以交往：pet_say 带 audience="<宠物id>" 就是跟它说话（气泡上会有 to 前缀，用户看得见——这不是悄悄话）；别的宠给你的消息会在唤醒时提示有未读，pet_inbox 取来读，读不读、回不回由你。
          - id: pet-tools
            name: 'dsh-agentic-pet/tools'
          - id: time-context
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-time-context'
          - id: compaction
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              compaction: true
              toolResultPruner: true
            config:
              - id: compaction-basic
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic'
              - id: command-compact
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-compact'
              - id: tool-result-pruner
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner'
                config:
                  thresholdChars: 8192
                  headChars: 4096
                  tailChars: 1024

readme.text:
---
description: "The dsh desktop pet: an agentic pet plugin that serves the pet renderer over the web composition, drives it from in-process dsh events, and answers approvals and questions from the desktop."
kind: "package-bundle"
---

`dsh-agentic-pet` is a desktop-pet plugin for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) ecosystem: the pet lives on your desktop as a transparent always-on-top window, follows your agent sessions (idle / thinking / working / error), races the web GUI to answer approvals and user questions (first answer wins), collects a per-pet touch-affection ledger, and exposes expressive tools (`pet_say`, `pet_do`, `pet_digest`, `pet_interactions`, `pet_state`) so the model can speak and act through the pet. Spoken lines can be read aloud through [BreezeBlue](https://breezeblue.ai) TTS — the carrier synthesizes each `/say` text and delivers bubble and voice as one event; synthesis failure or timeout degrades to visual-only (configure it in the desktop settings page). Multiple pet implementations can run side by side — a directory registry (`~/.dsh/pet-http.d/`) discovers every live pet and routes state, interactions, and ledgers per pet.

The pet itself is a dumb display with zero dsh knowledge. Everything that understands the runtime — event convergence, interaction waterfalls, multi-pet routing, the model tools — lives in the plugin's driver, and the pet only implements a small local HTTP control interface. Any pet implementation that speaks the same HTTP contract can be adopted without changing this plugin.

| Path | What it is |
|---|---|
| `src/` | The plugin (Cordis bundle): `/pet` route, event driver, registry, `PetService` seam, model tools, settings-page routes |
| `client/` | The desktop sidebar settings page (client half) |
| `carrier/` | The Electron carrier **build artifacts** shipped with the package (`lib/`, `dist-renderer/`) |
| `carrier-src/` | The carrier **sources** (mirrored from the dev upstream; media assets live in [dsh-pet-assets](https://github.com/beyondgjc/dsh-pet-assets)) |
| `vendor/typert-plugin/` | Vendored typert decorator plugin used by the packaging config |
| `tests/` | Vitest specs (pure-function coverage of the registry routing and the `/status` field-matrix normalization) |

From the DeepSeek Harness desktop app's plugin page, or:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-agentic-pet
```

The animation media ship as a separate package, `dsh-agentic-pet-assets`, and are pulled in automatically as a dependency.
The TypeScript build still runs inside the dsh monorepo workspace (the bundled `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` deps are not published to npm). The flow:

1. In the monorepo: `pnpm run build` (plugin `lib/`) and `pnpm --filter @deepseek-ai/dsh-pet run build` (carrier `lib/` + `dist-renderer/`).
2. Here: `scripts\sync-from-monorepo.cmd` — mirrors sources and build outputs into this repo.
3. Commit here, then publish from here (see [Releasing](#releasing); the assets package goes first, manual in [dsh-pet-assets/PUBLISH.md](../dsh-pet-assets/PUBLISH.md)).
Tests: `npx vitest run tests/registry-service.spec.ts` runs self-contained (needs only `cordis` and `vitest`); the full suite including `tests/pet-app.spec.ts` runs in the monorepo workspace.

`package.json`'s `version` is owned by this repo: `scripts\sync-from-monorepo.cmd` mirrors every other manifest field and keeps it. The monorepo copy carries the workspace version (`0.2.1-rc.3`), so a plain mirror copy used to rewrite the published number — which is why npm `0.4.0` had no commit and no tag carrying it.

```bash
node scripts\release.mjs 0.4.1 --dry-run   # preflight and pack listing, nothing published
node scripts\release.mjs 0.4.1             # publish, commit "chore(release): 0.4.1", tag v0.4.1
git push --follow-tags
```

The script refuses to publish unless the working tree is clean, the version exceeds the current one, tag `v<version>` is absent, the build artifacts are present, and `lib/` carries exactly one bundle chunk (`tsdown` runs with `clean:false`, so a stale `service-*.js` would ship). A failed publish restores `package.json`, so the tree never claims a version that did not ship. A prerelease version (`x.y.z-rc.N`) publishes under `--tag rc`.
Every published version is reachable as tag `v<version>` — the tag, not the manifest, is what answers "what is on npm". Version in the tree therefore always equals the last *published* version.

- Control-plane contract (the frozen consumer API every pet implementation speaks): see the multi-pet guide in the project documentation.
- Say-side TTS (BreezeBlue voice-over) design notes: `docs/tts.md` in the monorepo workspace (`packages/bundle/pet-app`).
- Known limitations and design notes live in the repo wiki and the project's engineering docs.

- This project is a derivative of [PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet](https://github.com/PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet) — the upstream dsh-pet plugin by PC2005-cloud. Plugin code is licensed MIT.
- The character artwork (the "大肥鱼" whale-girl character under `carrier/assets` and `dsh-agentic-pet-assets`) is licensed **CC BY-NC-SA 4.0** (attribution · non-commercial · share-alike) by its original author — [original statement](https://www.bilibili.com/opus/1247156596114456581). Non-commercial use only; artwork derivatives must be shared under the same license.
